bugs.title: Short glitches accepted as presses due to settle timing
bugs.description: The debounce in scanButton() only compares the raw level against rawLevel and resets rawChangedAt on any change (lines 27-31), then accepts the level once it has been stable for SETTLE_MS (lines 32-38). A 5 ms LOW glitch that happens to be sampled at the boundary can be treated as settled, and the blocking acknowledge() call (lines 18-20) then prevents further sampling, so subsequent real presses are missed. bugs.title: Debounce settle logic misses valid presses
bugs.description: scanStart() only accepts a press once rawLevel has been stable for SETTLE_MS (20 ms) at line 46, and it resets rawChangedAt on every edge at lines 41-45. A press that is interrupted by a bounce edge, or that arrives while a prior spike train keeps rawChangedAt fresh, never reaches the stable window, so openZone() at line 51 is never called; measured evidence shows D10 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 3.00 s, 1.02 s, and 1.00 s. Because the debounce requires a full 20 ms of uninterrupted stability before acting, presses near the settle boundary or with bounce spaced under 20 ms are dropped entirely rather than accepted. D10 missed 1 of 4 trigger(s): D10 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 3.00 s.

bugs.title: Presses during an open valve are dropped, so later presses never start a burst
bugs.description: In scanTrigger() line 49 the acceptance condition requires !valveOpen, so any settled press that arrives while the valve is open is discarded and pressed is still updated on line 53. When the valve closes at line 80, the button is already held-down state and no new edge occurs, so the press never produces a pulse; the engine measured "D8 missed 2 of 5 trigger(s): D8 did not start within 100 ms of the trigger at 500 ms" and again at 1.50 s. The spec only requires ignoring presses during the pulse, not losing presses that arrive near the end of it, and the 12 ms settle window on line 46 combined with this gating makes the miss reproducible. bugs.title: Running total overflows int, producing negative levels
bugs.description: `total` is declared as `int` on line 13, but it accumulates 40 ADC readings of up to 1023, so the sum can reach ~40920, which overflows the 16-bit signed int (max 32767). The overflowed negative total is then converted in averageMm() on line 28, yielding the measured printed values of -3811 mm, -3810 mm and -3816 mm while the injected level was ~4200 mm (off by ~8000 mm). Firmware printed -3811 mm at 3.02 s while the injected input was 4146.9 to 4254.6 mm: off by 7957.9 mm (tolerance ±40). 9 of 9 values were wrong.

bugs.title: Relay pulse length wrong and runs mistimed
bugs.description: The run is scheduled with a single-shot nextRunAt that is only advanced inside startRun (line 30), and the stop check at line 64 uses a 16-bit millis() comparison; the measured evidence shows pulses of 201 ms and 500 ms instead of 2000 ms (e.g. "pulse from 5.00 s lasted 201 ms, expected 2000 ± 150 ms"). Because the schedule is not re-armed relative to the cycle and the hold switch gates the output in drive() (line 46) without pausing the timer, the relay is cut short whenever D3 is LOW, so the 2000 ms run is never delivered. bugs.title: Relay chatters on bouncy hold input
bugs.description: held() at line 41 reads D3 directly with no debounce, and drive() at lines 46-47 writes the relay every loop iteration based on that raw reading, so contact bounce produces many edges (measured "16 toggles" in a 5000 ms window, limit 2). The bounce at the run boundary also toggles D6 repeatedly because running stays true while held() flickers, giving "10 toggles" starting at 5.15 s.
